scope: Read-only review of the actual recipe.sv diff against recipe.before.sv, with independent Boolean and metadata-transition exhaustion.

checks.name: scalar intake factoring
checks.evidence: A scalar fixed handshake requires IDLE, request_valid, !batch_mode and scalar_fixed. IDLE excludes FIXED_WAIT, so old ctx_response_ready cannot retire scalar tag 0. Keeping !busy[0] is exact at this handshake.

checks.name: batch intake factoring
checks.evidence: A public batch ready requires batch_mode and !bridge_response. Here scalar_bridge is false, so old ctx_response_ready equals batch_response_ready. Same-edge retire/refill remains in batch_slot_available.

checks.name: pending reservation and queue refill
checks.evidence: Both tag exclusion predicates remain unchanged. ctx_request_ready retains the original engine_mode gate through ctx_perm_ready. Under an enabled public intake, !pending_valid||accept factors to !pending_valid||(!again&&ready).

checks.name: no valid/no mode and invalid combinations
checks.evidence: The exact new OR form of receive and both public ready outputs match the prior equations over 786432 combinations. No busy/pending-idle invariant or valid-only assumption was used.

checks.name: registered recycle alignment
checks.evidence: In scheduled_execution P>1, stage P-1 always advances valid from P-2 and copies base from P-2 when valid. The added recycle flop uses the identical prior P-2 valid/base, so it equals the original final-stage predicate after every edge. Reset clears both valid and recycle; held base on bubbles is irrelevant.

checks.name: legal parameter coverage
checks.evidence: The register-transition predicate was exhausted for every 5-bit prior base and held final base, valid and reset, across all 22 legal P>1/U pairs. ROUNDS=24 yields constant-zero recycle. P1 scalar execution is unchanged.

checks.name: cycle and interface structure
checks.evidence: Only a precomputed control register is introduced; no request/data/response pipeline stage or port changes. Existing final metadata, permutation stage data updates, mode arbitration, streaming absorb and capture writes are untouched.

checks.name: debug observers
checks.evidence: Legacy ready/receive and recycle observers are entirely under ifndef SYNTHESIS, check at posedge outside reset and do not drive functional signals.

validation_pending_external_to_review: Recipe byte/hash regression in normal and SYNTHESIS views
Pipeline out-of-order, same-edge refill, capture/backpressure regression
limitations: two-state only; X/Z propagation is not exhaustively proved
equation proof is manually tied to inspected RTL, not parser-based equivalence
does not replace full hash/output/signature-cache simulation or routed STA
conclusion: No functional issue found in the reviewed change. The equations support unchanged two-state handshakes and cycle latency; runtime regressions and measured timing remain separate evidence.
